regions.title: First Steps
regions.blurb: Say hello, remember things, read input.
regions.story: Chilaka's village, Aata-gram, lost its welcome gate. Learn print, variables and input to rebuild it.

regions.title: Decisions
regions.story: The signposts at the crossroads are tangled. Use if, elif and else to point every traveller the right way.

regions.title: Loops
regions.story: The village water wheel has stopped. Loops keep it turning without writing the same line a hundred times.

regions.title: Strings
regions.story: The market stalls sell words, and the labels are jumbled. Text tools will sort them out.

regions.title: Collections
regions.story: The library shelves have collapsed. Collections hold many things in an order you choose.

regions.title: Functions
regions.story: The workshop needs tools that can be used again and again. Build your own functions.

regions.title: Files and Errors
regions.story: Letters are piling up at the post office. Files store them, and error handling keeps one bad letter from stopping everything.

regions.title: Modules and Debugging
regions.story: The toolshed is full of ready-made tools. Learn to import them, and to track down bugs when something breaks.

regions.title: Objects
regions.blurb: Bundle data and behaviour in classes.
regions.story: The guild hall keeps records of every member. Classes let you model real things in code.

regions.title: Clean Code
regions.story: The tower is messy. Names, tests and small functions make code clear for the next reader.

regions.title: Problem Solving
regions.blurb: Think in steps, search, sort, solve.
regions.story: The garden maze hides the way out. Algorithms are how you find it quickly.

regions.title: Real-World Python
regions.blurb: Parse logs, read APIs, build tools.
regions.story: The control room watches the whole village. Use Python to read logs, parse data and build command-line tools.

regions.title: Debug the Outage
regions.blurb: Linux troubleshooting, one outage at a time.
regions.story: A pager buzzes at 3 a.m. Fix the broken server before the village wakes.

regions.title: Select and Filter
regions.story: The Aata Market keeps its records in tables. Learn to ask for exactly the rows you need.

regions.title: Count and Group
regions.blurb: COUNT, SUM, AVG, GROUP BY, HAVING.
regions.story: The owner wants totals, averages and shelf reports. Let the database do the arithmetic.

regions.title: Join Tables
regions.story: Customers, orders and products live apart. Build bridges between them.

regions.title: Change the Data
regions.story: The village library needs books added, repriced and removed. Careful: DELETE has no undo.

regions.title: Git Basics
regions.story: Every great garden keeps a diary. Learn to save snapshots of your work.

regions.title: Branches and Merges
regions.story: Grow new ideas on their own branches, then graft them back safely.

regions.title: Undo Anything
regions.story: Mistakes happen. Git remembers where you have been.

regions.title: Python for DevOps
regions.story: Real operators automate the boring parts. Parse logs, read configs and build small tools.

regions.title: Interview Prep
regions.blurb: Classic questions, solved the Python way.
regions.story: Two Sum, brackets, intervals: the questions every interviewer loves.

regions.title: Mystery Cases
regions.blurb: Solve cases from clues in files and logs.
regions.story: Six cases, many witnesses. Follow the evidence with grep, sort, diff and cat.

regions.title: Code Golf Shrine
regions.story: Eight holes. Solve first, then shrink your code and beat par.

regions.title: Pair Parrot
regions.blurb: Review a confident parrot's buggy code.
regions.story: Chilaka wrote some code and is sure it is perfect. Work out what is wrong, then fix it.

regions.title: Go Basics
regions.story: Chilaka met a gopher at the edge of the grove. Go is small, fast and strict, and the compiler is a patient teacher.

regions.title: Go Data
regions.story: The grove keeps seeds in baskets of every shape. Slices, maps and structs hold them.

regions.title: Go Flow
regions.story: The mill needs steady flow. Control it with loops, functions and errors.

regions.title: Talk with curl
regions.story: The bazaar's API answers anyone who asks politely. Learn to ask with curl.

regions.title: APIs in Python
regions.story: Write Python that talks to APIs, and copes when they misbehave.

regions.title: Spot the Hole
regions.story: A watchtower sees what the village cannot. Learn to read code the way attackers do.

regions.title: Patch the Hole
regions.blurb: Fix real flaws, tested with attacks.
regions.story: Finding a flaw is half the job. Fix it so the attack no longer works.

regions.title: Lock the Server
regions.story: The vault door needs better locks. Harden a server from the terminal.

regions.title: Robot Maze
regions.blurb: Guide a parrot with loops and decisions.
regions.story: Gilaka the parrot follows your code through the hedge maze. Make loops and decisions do the walking.

regions.title: Pipeline Plumber
regions.story: Water, or text, flows through the pipes. Connect the parts so it comes out right.

regions.title: Project: Log Analyzer
regions.blurb: Build a real log analysis tool in 6 steps.
regions.story: Turn a pile of log lines into a clear report, one checkpoint at a time.

regions.title: Project: Key-Value Store
regions.blurb: Build a tiny database in 6 steps.
regions.story: Build the heart of every cache: a store that remembers, forgets and speaks commands.

regions.title: Project: Link Shortener
regions.blurb: Build a safe URL shortener in 6 steps.
regions.story: Short links, base 62, and a security check, built step by step.
